model: delta_dot=a-b*sin(delta), a=Ki*Pref, b=Ki*Pmax; ideal fixed PCC voltage, no inner loop, no current limiter switching, pure inductive network
gain_provenance: Table I: 9.3e-9 rad/(W s)*1e9 W; Table III: 9.3e-3*1e3 gives same 9.3
gain_pu_ambiguity: The stated 0.01 pu gain has no explicit base definition. Do not substitute 0.01*2*pi*50 for a; use dimensional gain product.

type_II_pu.fault_location: Sending end of line 2 after S3 and before Xg2 as drawn in Figure 1; grounded common node after XT while both lines remain connected

figures.start_time_source: visually read from Figure 9 and 10 axes
figures.experiment_absolute_times: not reconstructed, oscilloscope trigger origin not specified

methods: Exact projective Riccati flow via 2x2 matrix exponential (independent of paper arctangent formula)
Brent root finding for critical angle and time
DOP853 scalar ODE only as an independent numerical cross-check
Direct nodal circuit solve to check fault Thevenin power and current

current_scope_audit.basis: standard consistent three-phase power/phase-voltage normalization; actual paper current base not separately tabulated
current_scope_audit.interpretation: Exceedance flags leaving the paper stated no-limiter PSC validity region; does not establish actual switch timing or full converter behavior

physical_sensitivity.voltage_interpretation: Treat table voltage as phase RMS only in labeled SI-sensitivity branch because it approximately reconciles listed inductance pu; power formula uses phase peaks sqrt(2)*Vrms. This is an inference, not an explicit table definition.
physical_sensitivity.primary_parameters: stated per-unit reactances plus dimensional a=9.3; never tune parameters to force reported CCT

boundary_tests: Clear at CCT +/-1ms: same-well versus one-slip recapture in mathematical scalar model
Exactly at UEP is an unstable equilibrium boundary, not guaranteed attraction
Fault shunt Xgnd=.3,.5,.8 with fixed post-fault circuit: CCA unchanged but CCT changes
Arctangent primitive only real in a^2>b^2; use projective/hyperbolic representation for Type I and unwrap phase for multi-cycle travel
excluded: claiming reference plots quantitatively reproduced without raw data
